summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Connectify (Vite React + Express, in-memory mock DB). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass (1 skipped) - all mutate_state paths (PROCESS_WIN, daily bonus one-time, PURCHASE_ITEM prices 250/300/400/600 + theme_ocean 1000, USE_ITEM, INSUFFICIENT_PERMEN, MISSION_NOT_COMPLETE, UPDATE_PROFILE NO_WRITABLE_FIELDS, stale revision 409, CLAIM_ACHIEVEMENT_REWARD high_score +200 & double-claim rejection, OPEN_CHEST not-ready). Frontend: login (nickname->create password->TAP UNTUK BERMAIN->lobby) works; lobby shows username + 0 Permen pill; all four tiles (Toko, Misi, Collection, Pencapaian) reachable via aria-label; Misi screen has 5 daily & weekly missions, tabs mission-tab-harian/mingguan, reset timer, Klaim disabled for incomplete; Pencapaian screen shows achievement-screen with 5 filter chips and 0/58 summary; Collection screen has 4 tabs (avatar/tema/lencana/item) and Item tab shows 3/3/3/3 counts + chests durations; Toko lists items at 300/250/400/600 with x3 owned badges (shop-owned-* count=4); Play menu shows Onet/Block/Multiplayer + Tantangan Harian card with +500 bonus (daily-challenge-card & daily-challenge-play-button testIDs present); Chest sheet opens showing 'PETI BERIKUTNYA 0 / 5 PTS' and 3 KOSONG slots with chest-close-button. Purchase confirms via BELI ITEM? dialog before deducting.
critical_code_review_comments: cde.ts is 560+ lines and mixes many actions; consider splitting per-action handlers into modules for maintainability.
Legacy sanitization block in mutate_state (deletes profile.hp, flexCrown, etc.) is silent - fine for migration but log a warning when it triggers.
The RPC fallback path in mutate_state duplicates logic; the fallback branch is what the mock exercises so it is well tested, but ensure real Supabase RPC returns are validated in prod.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a fresh mock account via nickname `tuser<uuid>` and provisions on the fly (in-memory mock, wiped on server restart). No cleanup required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a Vite+React+Express app, NOT Expo. Preview at https://<preview>.emergentagent.com/. API base = /api/cde?action=... Mock auth header 'Authorization: Bearer mock-token:<nick>@connectify.com'. Restarting `expo` supervisor program wipes accounts. Login: nickname->LANJUT->create password->Buat Akun->tap-to-play screen (click screen center, e.g. mouse.click(195,400))->lobby. Lobby tiles use aria-label (Toko/Misi/Collection/Pencapaian). Purchase in Toko shows a BELI ITEM? confirmation dialog BEFORE showing 'Permen Kurang' - click YA, BELI to trigger insufficient-permen path.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration.
